findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - an earlier-adopted prototype uses saved SVG or PNG design pages without a design link.
The new filter excludes every design image because records.py:560 passes images=set(). The excluded files are then physically removed from the review checkout at review.py:865–870. Although design.source() lists these pages, the gap check cannot read them. A valid image-only design therefore loses the fallback promised by Done-when 5. The saved-pages test checks filenames in the prompt without checking that the pages reach the reviewer.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a coordinator follows the shipped sign-off instructions before the demo.
This command omits --by, but records.py:879 still declares that argument required. Argument parsing therefore stops before any sign-off check runs. The same unusable command appears in docs/guide.md:135 and both synced Forge skill copies. Include the required argument in each pre-demo instruction.
findings.title: Include the required --by argument in the pre-demo command

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the test suite runs the new-client and earlier-adopted canvas sign-off cases.
The patch deletes _preview without replacing its remaining calls at lines 57 and 94. It is neither defined nor imported anywhere in this module, so both parameterizations of test_4 and test_5 raise NameError before their behavior assertions. Restore the helper or replace both callers so these required proof tests can run.
findings.title: Gate: restore the helper still called by the canvas sign-off tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the required documentation test runs in the suite.
The new assertion requires “Forge copies the current `## Answers` section into the sign-off record”, while docs/guide.md:131 actually says “Forge copies the current Answers section into the record”. Whitespace normalization cannot reconcile those differences, so this assertion deterministically fails. Align the documentation check with the delivered contract.
